set -euo pipefail; SHA=08298e95ae46e807667b860141f21cf75eeaa15c; git fetch origin mvp/environment-controller; git reset --hard origin/mvp/environment-controller; git clean -fd; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$SHA"; PORT_S3="$(.venv/bin/python -c 'from tools.stage27c_soak import detect_ch340_port; print(detect_ch340_port())')"; PORT_S3="$PORT_S3" .venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
import os,time,serial
port=os.environ['PORT_S3']
end=time.monotonic()+40
lines=[]
with serial.Serial(port,115200,timeout=0.2,rtscts=False,dsrdtr=False) as s:
    s.rts=False; s.dtr=False
    while time.monotonic()<end:
        raw=s.readline()
        if not raw: continue
        line=raw.decode('utf-8','replace').rstrip()
        if 'stage27_sd' in line:
            print(line); lines.append(line)
before=any('level before mount=1' in x for x in lines)
after=any('level after mount failure=1' in x for x in lines)
failed=any('SD mount failed' in x for x in lines)
print(f'[AGENT_PROGRESS] power_before_high={str(before).lower()}')
print(f'[AGENT_PROGRESS] power_after_failure_high={str(after).lower()}')
print(f'[AGENT_PROGRESS] mount_failed={str(failed).lower()}')
if not (before and after and failed): raise SystemExit('Did not prove GPIO42 stayed high across failed mount retry')
PY
test -z "$(git status --short)"
